verdict.rationale: First-party sources document Advanced Voice Mode on mobile, a real-time conversation started by tapping the soundwave icon [chatgpt-docs-21, chatgpt-docs-41]. They also document ChatGPT Voice in the desktop app, where you can talk through ideas and start, check, or redirect tasks across Chat, Work, and Codex without typing [chatgpt-docs-51, chatgpt-docs-76, chatgpt-docs-13], plus voice conversations from the floating Pets controls [chatgpt-docs-105]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the conversation's latency and naturalness, and in-depth docs on conversational behavior such as interruptions and voice options.
